card.name: Start of words beginning with Ex-
card.fires_on: The word start 'Ex' or 'ex' at the beginning of a new word or table entry, such as Excessive, Excretory, Excludes, Exceeding, exogenous. It follows a sentence break, a table header, or a short linking word.

modes.label: Ex after a sentence or table break
modes.description: Capitalized 'Ex' opens a sentence, heading or table cell, before -cessive, -cretory, -cludes or -ceeding.
modes.example: patients with non-small cell lung cancer for up to 6 consecutive weeks concurrently with thoracic radiation. Non-concurrent (given >7 days apart)<< Ex>>cessive toxicity has not been observed when gem

modes.label: ex inside a phrase
modes.description: Lowercase 'ex' begins 'exogenous' after 'of' or 'with' in nutrition text.
modes.example: nutrition is impaired. However, if a patient is unable to take oral nourishment for a prolonged period of time, institution of total parenteral nutrition with<< ex>>ogenous calories should be considered. Central Ve
